text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower stands quietly
in front of the Three Goddesses fountain.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onii-sama...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onee-sama...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: They say if you offer a coin to the Three Goddesses' fountain and make a wish, it'll come true—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice thought about wishing to become someone
who can make everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Things like this...
how much should I offer...?"
choice_data_list: Let's put our feelings into that single coin.
Let's put in a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Rice will pour all of her feelings right into it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Dear Three Goddesses... Please,
grant Rice's wish...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Listen, Big Brother...!
Rice didn't make anyone unhappy today...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Big Sister...!
Rice didn't bring bad luck to anyone today...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was so peaceful,
a truly happy day for Rice and everyone else...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I hope so...
Maybe my wish... came true just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... It looks like the Three Goddesses fountain
has stopped running...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Rice will pour all of her feelings right into it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Dear Three Goddesses... Please,
grant Rice's wish...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah...!
Rice's ice cream was a winner...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Onii-sama... Would you mind taking
the bonus ice cream I won...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Onee-sama... Would you mind taking
the bonus ice cream I won...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... If Rice's good luck
can bring happiness to Big Brother... that makes me so glad.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... If Rice's good luck
can bring happiness to Big Sister... that makes me so glad.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... My wish actually came true...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... It looks like the Three Goddesses fountain
has stopped running...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Rice will pour all of her feelings right into it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Dear Three Goddesses... Please,
grant Rice's wish...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...! Rice bumped into you and caused trouble—

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text: What are you saying? If anything, you saved me!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't bumped into you, little lady,
I would've been hit by that speeding car.
...Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...?
Because of... Rice...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Three Goddesses... Thank you
for granting Rice's wish...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... It looks like the Three Goddesses fountain
has stopped running...

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The drain got clogged with coins.
I knew it was about time to clean it, but I wonder
if a lot of students have been making wishes lately?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No...
It's all because Rice inserted that coin...!
choice_data_list: It's not set in stone yet.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"No! It's always Rice's fault
whenever stuff like this happens... So this time must be too..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
M-Mr. Janitor...!
Rice will help clean up to make up for it...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... thank you!

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, you two!
Thanks to your help, we finished ahead of schedule!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, please...
It was Rice's fault for causing trouble in the first place...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still...
I'm just glad the fountain is clean and pretty again...
